title: Cognitive Vector Indexed Event
description: Emitted when a vector is added to FAISS similarity search index (P08 M24)

embedding_id.description: Unique identifier for the embedding record

indexed_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) when vector was indexed

batch_size.description: Number of vectors indexed in this batch (1 for single, N for batch)

index_stats.description: Optional FAISS index statistics after addition

total_vectors.description: Total number of vectors in index after addition

nprobe.description: FAISS search parameter (IVF cells to probe)
